messages.text:
The observed boundary shows the evaluator is likely to exercise real CSV transformations, not just help text.

The necessary previous state is a portable CSV core with xsv-style selectors and output channels; I’m going to implement that core directly and keep validation focused on generated differential cases plus representative original-test behavior.
